# robinhood-chain-mcp

> Model Context Protocol servers for Robinhood Chain: zero-config read-only data server plus an opt-in trading server with hard spend caps and confirm gates.

robinhood-chain-mcp is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
